answer.sourceLine: Lucasfilm documents Ford proposing and refining Han’s reply with director Irvin Kershner. The exchange belongs to The Empire Strikes Back (1980); Ford’s contribution is the reply, not sole authorship of both speakers’ dialogue.

author.metaLine: Screenplay writers; Ford contributed Han Solo’s reply
author.bio: Brackett and Kasdan hold the film’s screenplay credit. Lucasfilm documents Ford contributing Han Solo’s reply with director Irvin Kershner; this does not make Ford the sole author of the exchange.
